name: Sibara Electrical And Electronics
slogan: The best service you can trust
intro: Reliable, high-quality electrical, electronic, refrigeration, air conditioning, security and renewable energy solutions for residential, commercial and industrial clients.
about:
Sibara Electrical And Electronics is a 100% Black-owned South African company committed to delivering dependable electrical and technical services to residential, commercial and industrial clients.

We provide installation, maintenance, repair and technical support services for property owners, businesses, accommodation facilities and other organisations. For us, quality service goes beyond completing a job. It means building trust, keeping professional standards, putting safety first and building lasting relationships with our clients.

We are also passionate about empowering South African youth by giving students practical workplace exposure and technical skills for careers in the electrical and engineering sectors.
mission: To provide reliable, safe and high-quality electrical and technical solutions while developing practical skills and creating opportunities for South African youth.
vision: To become a trusted and recognised electrical and technical services company in South Africa, known for quality workmanship, innovation and youth development.

services.name: Electrical installation & maintenance
services.text: Installations, fault finding, repairs, maintenance, wiring, lighting and system upgrades for homes, businesses and industrial sites.

services.name: Air conditioning
services.text: Supply, installation, servicing, troubleshooting and maintenance of air conditioning systems.

services.name: Cold rooms & freezer rooms
services.text: Installation, servicing and repair of commercial refrigeration and temperature-controlled storage.

services.name: CCTV security systems
services.text: CCTV installation, maintenance, configuration and remote viewing on your phone.

services.name: Solar energy systems
services.text: Solar installations, inverter and battery solutions, and system maintenance designed around your needs.

services.name: Gate & garage motors
services.text: Installation, servicing and fault finding for automatic gate and garage door motors.

services.name: Appliance repairs
services.text: Troubleshooting and servicing of washing machines, refrigerators and other household appliances.

services.name: Generators
services.text: Generator installation support, servicing, maintenance and troubleshooting for reliable backup power.

services.name: Electric fencing
services.text: Electric fence installation, maintenance, fault finding and perimeter security.

services.name: Gas installations & geysers
services.text: Gas installations and geyser installation, servicing and maintenance, subject to the required certification and registration.

director.name: Elijah Sibara
director.bio:
Elijah completed his Electrical Engineering NATED studies at Vhembe TVET College in 2023, and his Electrical Trade Test training at Intouch Training Centre in the same year. His practical experience began while he was still studying, and he built his skills further at Makonisi Aircon and General Trading and at Tshakonda Electrical.

As director, Elijah is committed to dependable technical service, professional standards, and creating opportunities for young people to gain practical experience in the electrical and engineering fields.
